title: 彭博科技策略师Mandy：AI服务器推动戴尔股价飙升33%
speaker: Mandy

segments.en: And yes, they are benefiting from a new line of AI servers, which didn't exist two, three years back.
segments.zh: 是的，它们正受益于一条新的AI服务器产品线，这在两三年前还不存在。

segments.en: When you look at the size of these companies and the way they were growing in the past decade, and now suddenly everyone is talking about sustaining that double digit growth.
segments.zh: 看看这些公司的规模以及过去十年的增长方式，现在突然大家都在讨论如何维持两位数的增长。

segments.en: That's what's driving a reset and expectation. Dell stock popping 33%. It was crazy.
segments.zh: 这推动了预期的重置。戴尔股价飙升33%，太疯狂了。

segments.en: I mean, we did that live on Tim and Carol's show. It was insane.
segments.zh: 我们在Tim和Carol的节目中实时见证了这一幕，太疯狂了。
